overall_notes: The paper focuses on narrative scene illustration using LLMs to generate prompts for text-to-image models. While it involves NLG (scene descriptions, criteria generation), the main evaluation is human-based rather than using automated metrics. LLM-as-judge usage is clearly demonstrated for evaluating scene illustrations.
